Save Over $150

products.title: Smart One 4.0 Organic Cotton All-in-One - Ladder 10
products.body_html:
Smart Bottoms Smart One 4.0 

One Size | 10–35 lbs | 100% Certified Organic Cotton

The Smart One 4.0 is a premium organic cotton all-in-one cloth diaper designed for simplicity, absorbency, and long-term durability. This one-size reusable diaper fits most babies from 10 to 35 pounds and provides reliable leak protection without unnecessary bulk.

With ten absorbent layers of certified organic cotton and an attached insert that folds for customized absorbency, the Smart One 4.0 delivers performance and convenience in one streamlined design.

Why Parents Choose the Smart One 4.0

100% Certified Organic Cotton Interior

The diaper is lined with certified organic cotton, providing a natural fiber layer against baby’s skin. No synthetic stay-dry materials are used inside the diaper.

Ten Layers of Absorbency

Built with ten super absorbent layers, this all-in-one diaper is designed to handle everyday wear while maintaining a trim fit.

Customizable Absorbency

The attached insert can be folded to concentrate absorbency exactly where your baby needs it most, making it suitable for both light and heavier wetters.

True All-in-One Convenience

Everything is sewn in. No stuffing, snapping, or assembling required. Diaper changes are quick and straightforward, making this an ideal option for caregivers, daycare, or cloth diaper beginners.

Faster Dry Time

The unique design allows for efficient washing and drying. Most machines will fully dry the diaper in one warm cycle.

Gentle, Leak-Reducing Fit

Wide, rolled leg elastic helps:

  • Reduce red marks
  • Improve comfort
  • Prevent leaks

Materials

Inner: 100% Certified Organic Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.
  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.
  3. Wash warm.
  4. Dry warm.
  5. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Dream Diaper 3.0 Natural Fiber Pocket Diaper - Ladder 10
products.body_html:
Smart Bottoms Dream Diaper 3.0

Product Description

The Smart Bottoms Dream Diaper 3.0 is a natural fiber pocket and all-in-two hybrid cloth diaper designed for customizable absorbency, fast moisture control, and long-term durability.

Made from a premium bamboo viscose and cotton blend, this reusable cloth diaper offers superior absorption speed while keeping synthetic materials away from baby’s skin. The detachable snap-in insert allows you to use it as a traditional pocket diaper or an all-in-two system, depending on your preference.

The pocket opening is reinforced and generously sized to fit most brands of inserts, flats, or prefolds, giving you flexibility without limiting your options.

Key Features

Natural Fiber Interior

Even the pocket lining is made from our highly absorbent 70% bamboo viscose and 30% cotton blend. No synthetic stay-dry layer sits against baby’s skin.

Fast, High-Capacity Absorbency

Our custom bamboo/cotton blend absorbs more quickly than hemp or cotton alone, helping reduce leaks and improve overall performance.

Hybrid Pocket + All-in-Two Design

The snap-in insert can be:

  • Used on top of the pocket shell
  • Folded to customize absorbency

Detached and stuffed inside the pocket for added protection

This flexibility makes it easy to adjust for daytime, naps, or heavier wetters.

Reinforced Universal Pocket

The strengthened pocket opening creates ample space for boosting while maintaining a trim fit. Compatible with:

  • Most brand inserts
  • Flat diapers
  • Prefolds
  • Doublers

Materials

Inner: 70% Bamboo Viscose, 30% Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.
  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.
  3. Rinse soiled diapers with warm water.
  4. Wash on hot using the detergent amount recommended for a heavily soiled load.
  5. Dry on warm.
  6. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Nighttime Trainer - Ladder 10
products.body_html:
The Nighttime Trainer features 4 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to prevent puddles, the perfect combination for children new to potty learning or those that need a little nighttime protection. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet.
While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Nighttime Trainer will hold an average accident but will need to be changed immediately. If the trainer is left on too long after an accident, if the child is sitting when they have an accident, or if the output is greater than the absorbency capacity, some urine may leak around the legs. This product is not meant to function as a diaper. If your child is not showing signs of potty training readiness, continuing to use a diaper is recommended. For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.  

 Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable diaper sizing. Please check our size chart available on our website before ordering.
 
Material Contents:
Interior:  4 layers of 80% Bamboo Rayon and 20% Polyester (backside of fabric only)
Waistbands, legs, & sides: 94% Polyester and 6 % Spandex
Wet Zone is reinforced with laminated TPU
 
Care Instructions:
This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.
Remove any solid waste from trainer and rinse with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Pull-On Diaper - Ladder 10
products.body_html:
The Smart Bottoms' Pull-On cloth diaper makes diaper changes a breeze! The super stretchy waist and legs make pulling the diaper up and down a cinch! The stay dry lining is designed to keep your child cool and dry, while the built-in bamboo absorbency locks moisture in the core of the diaper for a leak-free fit. A hidden pocket allows you to add additional inserts (included) if your child needs more absorbency for longer wear or overnight. Waterproof leg gussets help keep everything contained. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart available on our website before ordering.

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 80% Bamboo Rayon/ 20% Polyester (back of fabric only for extra durability) 

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of bamboo terry sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer bamboo terry insert provided.

For families facing the challenge of managing incontinence in children, the financial aspect can be overwhelming. Click here to read about insurance coverage for reusable incontinence supplies.

products.title: Daytime Trainer - Ladder 10
products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.

Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of bamboo terry sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer bamboo terry insert provided.

For families facing the challenge of managing incontinence in children, the financial aspect can be overwhelming. Click here to read about insurance coverage for reusable incontinence supplies.

products.title: Daytime Trainer - Odette
products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. If they are having frequent accidents or are new to potty training, we recommend starting out with our Nighttime Trainer, they will offer twice the absorbency to help catch bigger accidents.

For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.  

 Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable diaper sizing. Please check our size chart available on our website before ordering.
 
Material Contents:
Interior:  4 layers of 80% Bamboo Rayon and 20% Polyester (backside of fabric only)
Waistbands, legs, & sides: 94% Polyester and 6 % Spandex
Wet Zone is reinforced with laminated TPU
 
Care Instructions:
This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.
Remove any solid waste from trainer and rinse with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Made from a premium bamboo viscose and cotton blend, this reusable cloth diaper offers superior absorption speed while keeping synthetic materials away from baby’s skin. The detachable snap-in insert allows you to use it as a traditional pocket diaper or an all-in-two system, depending on your preference.

The pocket opening is reinforced and generously sized to fit most brands of inserts, flats, or prefolds, giving you flexibility without limiting your options.

Key Features

Natural Fiber Interior

Even the pocket lining is made from our highly absorbent 70% bamboo viscose and 30% cotton blend. No synthetic stay-dry layer sits against baby’s skin.

Fast, High-Capacity Absorbency

Our custom bamboo/cotton blend absorbs more quickly than hemp or cotton alone, helping reduce leaks and improve overall performance.

Hybrid Pocket + All-in-Two Design

The snap-in insert can be:

  • Used on top of the pocket shell

  • Folded to customize absorbency

  • Detached and stuffed inside the pocket for added protection

This flexibility makes it easy to adjust for daytime, naps, or heavier wetters.

Reinforced Universal Pocket

The strengthened pocket opening creates ample space for boosting while maintaining a trim fit. Compatible with:

  • Most brand inserts

  • Flat diapers

  • Prefolds

  • Doublers

Materials

Inner: 70% Bamboo Viscose, 30% Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.

  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.

  3. Rinse soiled diapers with warm water.

  4. Wash on hot using the detergent amount recommended for a heavily soiled load.

  5. Dry on warm.

  6. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Why Choose the Dream Diaper 3.0?

  • Natural fiber cloth diaper

  • Bamboo cotton pocket diaper

  • Hybrid all-in-two cloth diaper system

  • Customizable absorbency

  • Compatible with most inserts

  • Reusable and eco-friendly

  • Breathable waterproof outer

products.title: RLR Natural Laundry Treatment - Diaper Stripping Powder
products.body_html:
Restore your cloth diapers to peak performance with RLR Laundry Treatment, a powerful yet gentle solution designed to remove deep-set mineral deposits, detergent buildup, and trapped odors. If your diapers are repelling, leaking, or holding onto smells even after washing, RLR helps reset your fabric so it can absorb properly again.

Trusted by cloth diapering families for decades, RLR works at the fiber level to break down residue caused by hard water, excess detergent, and repeated wash cycles—without damaging fabrics.

Why Use RLR for Cloth Diapers?

Over time, cloth diapers can develop buildup that affects absorbency and performance. RLR Laundry Treatment helps:

  • Remove mineral buildup from hard water
  • Eliminate detergent residue
  • Restore absorbency and softness
  • Reduce lingering odors and ammonia smells
  • Improve overall diaper performance

Safe for all cloth diaper types, including cotton, bamboo, hemp, and microfiber.

How to Strip Cloth Diapers with RLR

Stripping your diapers with RLR is simple and effective. Follow these steps:

Step 1: Start Clean

Wash your diapers as usual to remove surface dirt and waste. Do not dry them.

Step 2: Prepare the RLR Bath

Fill your washing machine or bathtub with hot water.
Add 1 packet of RLR Laundry Treatment per load and dissolve completely.

Step 3: Soak

Add clean, wet diapers to the solution.
Soak for 30 minutes - 1 hour, stirring occasionally to help release buildup.

Step 4: Rinse Thoroughly

Drain the water and rinse diapers multiple times until the water runs clear and free of suds.

Step 5: Wash Again

Run one full wash cycle with no detergent to ensure all residue is removed.

Step 6: Sanitize

If odors persist use 1/2 cup of chlorine bleach in your wash cycle to sanitize diapers. Do an extra rinse.

Step 7: Dry

Dry diapers as usual. You should notice improved absorbency and freshness.

When Should You Strip Diapers?

Consider using RLR if you notice:

  • Diapers leaking despite proper fit
  • Strong odors after washing or once child urinates
  • Stiff or crunchy fabric
  • Repelling (liquid pooling instead of absorbing)

Product Details

  • Includes: Single-use RLR Laundry Treatment packets
  • Works in all washing machines (HE and standard)
  • Phosphate-free formula
  • Made in the USA

Pro Tip

For households with hard water, regular maintenance (proper detergent amounts and occasional deep cleaning) can help reduce the need for frequent stripping.

Product Description

The side-snapping swim diaper from Smart Bottoms features two rows of snaps on each side, allowing you to adjust for the perfect fit.* Our swim diaper is lined with a moisture wicking fabric to help prevent rashes and keep solids contained. This diaper meets the requirements for most public pools. Swim diapers do not require any additional diaper. They are intended to retain solids, not liquids. products.title: Dream Diaper 3.0 Natural Fiber Pocket Diaper - Happy Camper
products.body_html:
Smart Bottoms Dream Diaper 3.0

Product Description

The Smart Bottoms Dream Diaper 3.0 is a natural fiber pocket and all-in-two hybrid cloth diaper designed for customizable absorbency, fast moisture control, and long-term durability.

Made from a premium bamboo viscose and cotton blend, this reusable cloth diaper offers superior absorption speed while keeping synthetic materials away from baby’s skin. The detachable snap-in insert allows you to use it as a traditional pocket diaper or an all-in-two system, depending on your preference.

The pocket opening is reinforced and generously sized to fit most brands of inserts, flats, or prefolds, giving you flexibility without limiting your options.

Key Features

Natural Fiber Interior

Even the pocket lining is made from our highly absorbent 70% bamboo viscose and 30% cotton blend. No synthetic stay-dry layer sits against baby’s skin.

Fast, High-Capacity Absorbency

Our custom bamboo/cotton blend absorbs more quickly than hemp or cotton alone, helping reduce leaks and improve overall performance.

Hybrid Pocket + All-in-Two Design

The snap-in insert can be:

  • Used on top of the pocket shell
  • Folded to customize absorbency

Detached and stuffed inside the pocket for added protection

This flexibility makes it easy to adjust for daytime, naps, or heavier wetters.

Reinforced Universal Pocket

The strengthened pocket opening creates ample space for boosting while maintaining a trim fit. Compatible with:

  • Most brand inserts
  • Flat diapers
  • Prefolds
  • Doublers

Materials

Inner: 70% Bamboo Viscose, 30% Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.
  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.
  3. Rinse soiled diapers with warm water.
  4. Wash on hot using the detergent amount recommended for a heavily soiled load.
  5. Dry on warm.
  6. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Daytime Trainer - Moo & You
products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. If they are having frequent accidents or are new to potty training, we recommend starting out with our Nighttime Trainer, they will offer twice the absorbency to help catch bigger accidents.

For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.  

 Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable diaper sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:
 
Material Contents:
Interior:  2 layers of 80% Bamboo Rayon and 20% Polyester (backside of fabric only)
Waistbands, legs, & sides: 94% Polyester and 6 % Spandex
Wet Zone is reinforced with laminated TPU
 
Care Instructions:
This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.
Remove any solid waste from trainer and rinse with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Nighttime Trainer - Moo & You
products.body_html:
The Nighttime Trainer features 4 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to prevent puddles, the perfect combination for children new to potty learning or those that need a little nighttime protection. products.title: Daytime Trainer - Campfire Tails
products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. If they are having frequent accidents or are new to potty training, we recommend starting out with our Nighttime Trainer, they will offer twice the absorbency to help catch bigger accidents.

products.title: Pull-On Diaper - Haulin
products.body_html:
The Smart Bottoms' Pull-On cloth diaper makes diaper changes a breeze! The super stretchy waist and legs make pulling the diaper up and down a cinch! The stay dry lining is designed to keep your child cool and dry, while the built-in bamboo absorbency locks moisture in the core of the diaper for a leak-free fit. A hidden pocket allows you to add additional inserts (included) if your child needs more absorbency for longer wear or overnight. Waterproof leg gussets help keep everything contained. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 80% Bamboo Rayon/ 20% Polyester (back of fabric only for extra durability) 

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of bamboo terry sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer bamboo terry insert provided.

products.title: Swim Diaper - Siren
products.body_html:
Smart Bottoms Swim Diaper - Siren

ALL SALES ARE FINAL ON THESE ITEMS. 

Product Description

The side-snapping swim diaper from Smart Bottoms features two rows of snaps on each side, allowing you to adjust for the perfect fit.* Our swim diaper is lined with a moisture wicking fabric to help prevent rashes and keep solids contained. This diaper meets the requirements for most public pools. Swim diapers do not require any additional diaper. They are intended to retain solids, not liquids. A reusable absorbent insert may be placed inside when baby is not in the water. We do not recommend any absorbent material be used with this product in the water as it may weigh the child down. This cover may be used over a disposable swim diaper to meet the requirements of public pools. Made in the USA.

Material Contents

Inner & Outer: 100% Polyester

Care Instructions

Wash and dry warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Sizing: Small (8-16lbs), Medium (16-30lbs), Large (30-50lbs). 
  • Adjustable side snaps on each side.
  • Gentle elastic around waist and legs won't leave red marks. Also chlorine resistant.
  • Snaps may be off-set to get the perfect fit around the waist and legs.

Keep beach gear organized and matching with our On-the Go Mesh Bags or Small Mesh Bags!

products.title: Nighttime Trainer - Deer Friends
products.body_html:
The Nighttime Trainer features 4 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to prevent puddles, the perfect combination for children new to potty learning or those that need a little nighttime protection. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet.
While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Nighttime Trainer will hold an average accident but will need to be changed immediately. If the trainer is left on too long after an accident, if the child is sitting when they have an accident, or if the output is greater than the absorbency capacity, some urine may leak around the legs. This product is not meant to function as a diaper. If your child is not showing signs of potty training readiness, continuing to use a diaper is recommended. For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.  

 Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable diaper sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:
 
Material Contents:
Interior:  4 layers of 80% Bamboo Rayon and 20% Polyester (backside of fabric only)
Waistbands, legs, & sides: 94% Polyester and 6 % Spandex
Wet Zone is reinforced with laminated TPU
 
Care Instructions:
This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.
Remove any solid waste from trainer and rinse with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.title: Pull-On Diaper - Dirt Life
products.body_html:
The Smart Bottoms' Pull-On cloth diaper makes diaper changes a breeze! The super stretchy waist and legs make pulling the diaper up and down a cinch! The stay dry lining is designed to keep your child cool and dry, while the built-in bamboo absorbency locks moisture in the core of the diaper for a leak-free fit. A hidden pocket allows you to add additional inserts (included) if your child needs more absorbency for longer wear or overnight. Waterproof leg gussets help keep everything contained. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 80% Bamboo Rayon/ 20% Polyester (back of fabric only for extra durability) 

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of bamboo terry sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer bamboo terry insert provided.

For families facing the challenge of managing incontinence in children, the financial aspect can be overwhelming. Click here to read about insurance coverage for reusable incontinence supplies.

The stay dry lining is designed to keep your child cool and dry, while the built-in bamboo absorbency locks moisture in the core of the diaper for a leak-free fit. A hidden pocket allows you to add additional inserts (included) if your child needs more absorbency for longer wear or overnight. Waterproof leg gussets help keep everything contained. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 80% Bamboo Rayon/ 20% Polyester (back of fabric only for extra durability) 

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of bamboo terry sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer bamboo terry insert provided.

products.title: Daytime Trainer - Navy
products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. If they are having frequent accidents or are new to potty training, we recommend starting out with our Nighttime Trainer, they will offer twice the absorbency to help catch bigger accidents.

For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.  

 Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable diaper sizing. Please check our size chart before ordering:
 
Material Contents:
Interior:  2 layers of 80% Bamboo Rayon and 20% Polyester (backside of fabric only)
Waistbands, legs, & sides: 94% Polyester and 6 % Spandex
Wet Zone is reinforced with laminated TPU
 
Care Instructions:
This trainer is made from natural fibers and will need to be washed and dried a minimum of three times before first use. It will increase in absorbency up to 8-10 washes.
Remove any solid waste from trainer and rinse with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.body_html:
The Daytime Trainer features 2 super absorbent layers of bamboo fabric in the wet zone and a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles,  the perfect combination for children that are nearly self-sufficient in using the toilet but may still have the occasional accident. The stretchy waist and legs allow your child to easily pull the trainer up & down on their own, giving them confidence and independence in this new stage of their life. The natural fiber interior allows your child to instantly feel when they have had an accident which will help them better understand when they need to use the toilet. Many of our customers will continue to use the Daytime Trainers, even once accident free, due to how trim and comfortable they are for their child.

While our trainers do have a waterproof layer to help prevent puddles, they are not intended to replace a diaper. The Daytime Trainer will hold a small accident but if a toddler completely eliminates their bladder, or has more than one accident, it will likely leak. If your child is not showing signs of readiness continuing to use a diaper is recommended. If they are having frequent accidents or are new to potty training, we recommend starting out with our Nighttime Trainer, they will offer twice the absorbency to help catch bigger accidents.

For our step-by-step guide to potty training, click here.

Do you feel like your child isn't quite ready to potty train yet? We have a solution for you!  Our Pull-On Diaper is designed similarly to the trainer but has the absorbency and leak protection you would expect in a diaper.

products.title: Pull-On Diaper - Daisies
products.body_html:
ALL SALES ARE FINAL ON THESE ITEMS. 

Smart Bottoms Pull On Cloth Diaper - Daisies

Product Description

The Smart Bottoms' Pull On cloth diaper is a less-prep all-in-one pull on cloth diaper made from a blend of certified organic cotton and hemp. The pocket can be stuffed with an additional insert for extra absorbency. The super stretchy waist and legs make pulling up and down a cinch, even on the squirmiest of children. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart available on our website before ordering.

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 55% Hemp Viscose / 45% Organic Cotton

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

 

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of organic cotton/hemp fleece sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer organic cotton/hemp insert provided

Proudly Made In The USA

products.title: Cloth Diaper Rental - $60/month
products.body_html:
Our one-size cloth diaper covers and all-in-ones start fitting at approximately 10-12 lbs. Our Newborn all-in-ones will fit 5lbs up to 16lbs, depending on the birth weight of the baby.

For $60/month (disposables average $90-$120 per month), you will get NEW cloth diapers without the upfront investment or long term commitment cloth diapering usually requires.

Choose from Newborn all-in-ones (24), One-size Covers (6) and Preflats (24), One-Size all-in-ones (12), or Trainers (6) Nighttime (6) Daytime.

Newborn and Trainer rentals require a minimum two month rental and the One-Size options require a six month rental.

A $150 deposit is required for each rental. When your diapers are returned in good, used condition you will receive this deposit back in the form of a credit that can be used at smartbottoms.com or bumblito.com. If you decide cloth diapering isn't for you, bumblito.com has clothing for newborns through pre-teen, as well as blankets and some adult clothing items. 

If you decide you love cloth diapering and want to use them on multiple children, you will have the option after six months to purchase them and your rental fee and deposit will be applied to the retail price of your package, making it virtually an interest free payment program.

Colors will vary from colors shown in picture."Blues" may include colors traditionally labeled as "boy," as well as other neutral colors. "Pinks" may include pinks and purples, as well as other neutral colors. "Neutral" may include yellow, white, orange, brown, green, aqua, gray, black, etc. We aim to avoid gender stereotyping colors. :)

We will ship within a week of receiving your order and the "rental" will begin a week after that. If you are a planner and are ordering weeks or months before baby arrives just email us and we are happy to hold your order until closer to your due date so it's one less thing you need to worry about.

We understand that diapers see some terrible things, so we do not expect your rental returns to be completely stain free, however they must be clean, dry, and have no obvious signs of damage. Diapers returned dirty, smelly, or damaged will impact the amount of the deposit that is returned to the customer. 

By making this purchase, you are agreeing to the minimum monthly rental stated above. Once you are ready to cancel your rental, send us an email and we will send you a prepaid return label to send them back. Deposits will be credited within 3 business days of receiving your returned rental.

Have questions about your cloth diapers? We are always here and happy to help! Simply email customercare@smartbottoms.com (anytime) or call 616-723-0093 (M-F 9am-5pm EST) for support.

products.body_html:
Smart Bottoms Pull On Cloth Diaper - Savannah

ALL SALES ARE FINAL ON THESE ITEMS. 

Product Description

The Smart Bottoms' Pull On cloth diaper is a less-prep all-in-one pull on cloth diaper made from a blend of certified organic cotton and hemp. The pocket can be stuffed with an additional insert for extra absorbency. The super stretchy waist and legs make pulling up and down a cinch, even on the squirmiest of children. 

Please Note: Our sizing DOES NOT correlate to disposable sizing. Please check our size chart available on our website before ordering.

Material Contents

Lining: 100%  Polyester Athletic Wicking Jersey

Absorbency: 55% Hemp Viscose / 45% Organic Cotton

Waistbands, legs, & sides: 95% Polyester / 5% Spandex

Waterproof Layer: 100% PUL

Prep Instructions

 

Turn the diaper inside out and wash at least three times before using. Insert should be removed from the pocket and also washed at least three time prior to first use. Depending on detergent you are using and water hardness they will continue to increase absorbency up to 8 washes. Dry on warm at least once prior to first use to shrink up fibers and increase absorbency.

Care Instructions

Remove any solid waste. Turn diaper inside out and rinse with warm water, this can be a prewash in your machine or they can be hand rinsed. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load of laundry. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • Wet Zone exterior made from waterproof PUL
  • Athletic Wicking Jersey (AWJ) lining to keep your baby feeling dry
  • 4 layers of organic cotton/hemp fleece sewn into the diaper for superior absorbency 
  • Interior gussets around the legs to prevent leaks
  • Super stretchy, elastic-free, legs and waist for easy up and down
  • Pocket for adding extra absorbency
  • One 4 layer organic cotton/hemp insert provided 

Proudly Made In The USA

products.body_html:
Save money and get a package in the mail every month with our Smart One 4.0 Subscription. With this subscription we will send a Smart One 4.0 Diaper every month. One Size | 10–35 lbs | 100% Certified Organic Cotton

The Smart One 4.0 is a premium organic cotton all-in-one cloth diaper designed for simplicity, absorbency, and long-term durability. This one-size reusable diaper fits most babies from 10 to 35 pounds and provides reliable leak protection without unnecessary bulk.

With ten absorbent layers of certified organic cotton and an attached insert that folds for customized absorbency, the Smart One 4.0 delivers performance and convenience in one streamlined design.

Why Parents Choose the Smart One 4.0

100% Certified Organic Cotton Interior

The diaper is lined with certified organic cotton, providing a natural fiber layer against baby’s skin. No synthetic stay-dry materials are used inside the diaper.

Ten Layers of Absorbency

Built with ten super absorbent layers, this all-in-one diaper is designed to handle everyday wear while maintaining a trim fit.

Customizable Absorbency

The attached insert can be folded to concentrate absorbency exactly where your baby needs it most, making it suitable for both light and heavier wetters.

True All-in-One Convenience

Everything is sewn in. No stuffing, snapping, or assembling required. Diaper changes are quick and straightforward, making this an ideal option for caregivers, daycare, or cloth diaper beginners.

Faster Dry Time

The unique design allows for efficient washing and drying. Most machines will fully dry the diaper in one warm cycle.

Gentle, Leak-Reducing Fit

Wide, rolled leg elastic helps:

  • Reduce red marks
  • Improve comfort
  • Prevent leaks

Materials

Inner: 100% Certified Organic Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.
  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.
  3. Wash warm.
  4. Dry warm.
  5. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

products.body_html:

The Smart Bottoms Dream Diaper 3.0 is a natural fiber pocket and all-in-two hybrid cloth diaper designed for customizable absorbency, fast moisture control, and long-term durability.

Made from a premium bamboo viscose and cotton blend, this reusable cloth diaper offers superior absorption speed while keeping synthetic materials away from baby’s skin. The detachable snap-in insert allows you to use it as a traditional pocket diaper or an all-in-two system, depending on your preference.

The pocket opening is reinforced and generously sized to fit most brands of inserts, flats, or prefolds, giving you flexibility without limiting your options.

Key Features

Natural Fiber Interior

Even the pocket lining is made from our highly absorbent 70% bamboo viscose and 30% cotton blend. No synthetic stay-dry layer sits against baby’s skin.

Fast, High-Capacity Absorbency

Our custom bamboo/cotton blend absorbs more quickly than hemp or cotton alone, helping reduce leaks and improve overall performance.

Hybrid Pocket + All-in-Two Design

The snap-in insert can be:

  • Used on top of the pocket shell
  • Folded to customize absorbency
  • Detached and stuffed inside the pocket for added protectio

This flexibility makes it easy to adjust for daytime, naps, or heavier wetters.

Reinforced Universal Pocket

The strengthened pocket opening creates ample space for boosting while maintaining a trim fit. Compatible with:

  • Most brand inserts
  • Flat diapers
  • Prefolds
  • Doublers

Materials

Inner: 70% Bamboo Viscose, 30% Cotton
Outer: 100% TPU (waterproof and breathable)

Care Instructions

  1. Wash 1–2 times before first use to prep the fibers.
  2. Absorbency will continue to increase with regular washing and drying.
  3. Rinse soiled diapers with warm water.
  4. Wash on hot using the detergent amount recommended for a heavily soiled load.
  5. Dry on warm.
  6. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Smart Bottoms Dream 2.0 Cloth Diaper - Chasing Rainbows

Product Description

The Smart Bottoms' Dream Diaper 2.0 cloth diaper is a less-prep all-in-one cloth diaper made from a blend of certified organic cotton and hemp. The snap-in insert can be detached and replaced with our Dream Diaper Overnight Insert for extra absorbency. 

Material Contents

Outer: 100% PUL, Inner: 55% Hemp Viscose, 45% Organic Cotton

Care Instructions

Rinse soiled diapers with warm water. Wash on hot with the amount of detergent recommended for your machine for a heavily soiled load. Dry on warm. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

Features

  • No Prep Natural Fiber Interior
  • Reinforced Pocket - the pocket opening is sewn in by the tabs and creates a generous space to fit all insert options.
  • Snap-in Insert
  • Matches perfectly with one of our super absorbent Bandana Bibs!
